description: Every sub-processor notice window Xither can quote: the number of days (business days where the clause says so) each vendor's own terms state for a new sub-processor, and what that number counts (basis: 'objection' = time to object once told, 'notice' = notice before the change, 'unstated' = the clause does not settle it), with the verbatim clause, its source URL and the date Xither read it. The same table as www.xither.com/notice-windows. A vendor not listed has no window Xither could quote.
name: notice_windows
title: Sub-processor notice windows
